metadata.title: Minimal immersions by first eigenfunctions of Riemann surfaces with large conformal automorphism groups. The Klein quartic
metadata.abstract: Minimal immersions of closed surfaces into spheres by first eigenfunctions play an important role in both the theory of minimal surfaces and spectral geometry. In this paper, we establish the existence of equivariant conformal minimal immersions of this type for Hurwitz surfaces and other families of %Riemann surfaces with large automorphism group. Finally, we explicitly construct a conformal minimal equivariant immersion of the Klein quartic into the unit sphere $S^{7}$ by first eigenfunctions. Ths immersion is a natural candidate for maximizing the normalized $\lambda_1$ among closed genus-3 surfaces.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 为 Hurwitz 曲面及其他大自同构群曲面建立等变共形首特征函数极小球面浸入，并显式构造 Klein 四次曲线到 S⁷ 的实例。
analysis.breakthrough: 提供亏格三谱极值问题的具体几何候选者。
analysis.limitations: 摘要只称其为正规化第一特征值最大化的自然候选，未声称解决亏格三全局极值。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。

analysis.priorityReason: 谱几何与极小曲面的直接联系，显式候选值得进一步检查。
